items.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
items.blurb: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

items.title: A UAF turned RCE
items.blurb: In the curl 8.23.0 release we shipped a fix for one of the worst vulnerabilities in curl in a long time. We grade it severity HIGH. It is known as CVE-2026-92392 with the title HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free.

items.title: ZCS Command Injection via SNMP Handlers Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.blurb: A critical remote command execution vulnerability in the Zimbra Collaboration Suite, identified as CVE-2026-73570, poses risks by allowing unauthorized access to mailbox data and credentials.
